statements.text: Functionalism is the doctrine that what makes something a thought, desire or pain depends not on its internal constitution but on its function, the role it plays in the cognitive system it belongs to. A mental state is identified by its causal relations to sensory stimulation, to other mental states and to behavior.

sources.quote: Functionalism is the doctrine that what makes something a thought, desire, pain (or any other type of mental state) depends not on its internal constitution, but solely on its function, or the role it plays, in the cognitive system of which it is a part.
